info.name: Ecommerce - Local
info.description:
Toan bo mat tiep xuc HTTP cua he thong, goi duoc ngay sau khi import.

## Chay truoc
Stack local phai dang chay: `./scripts/local-up.ps1` (hoac `.sh`). Chon environment **Ecommerce - Local** o goc tren ben phai Postman.

## Quy tac header - doc truoc khi sua bat ky request nao
- Request **qua gateway** (`{{gatewayUrl}}`) KHONG mang `X-Tenant-Id` hay `X-Subject-Id`. Gateway tu phan giai danh tinh va ghi de moi gia tri client gui len. Gan header vao se tao cam giac sai rang client quyet dinh duoc tenant, trong khi day chinh la dieu he thong chan.
- Request **goi thang BFF hoac domain service** BAT BUOC mang ca hai header. Thieu tenant thi domain service tra 500; thieu subject thi cac endpoint theo nguoi mua tra 500. BFF chi relay chu khong tu phan giai.
- `X-Correlation-Id` duoc pre-request script cap collection tu sinh cho moi request, de doi chieu log khi can.

## Cach chay
Folder **00 - Smoke Flow** chay tuan tu tu tren xuong bang Collection Runner va ket thuc bang mot don hang that. Cac folder con lai xep theo master feature khop `docs/test-cases-2026-08-20.xlsx`; moi request ghi ma test case tuong ung trong phan description.

## Doi sang staging
Khong request nao hardcode host hay cong. Duplicate environment nay, dien lai cac bien URL la chay duoc; nhung environment tren staging thuong chi co `gatewayUrl`, cac bien con lai de trong va cac folder goi thang service se that bai - dung nhu ky vong, vi staging khong publish chung.
